methods.relevance: Issuer-matched company developments and established market desks can introduce new topics. Promotional articles are dropped and copies deduplicated. Market/company items expire after four days; official releases after 30 days. Publication and upstream retrieval dates remain separate; items over 72 hours are older context.
methods.interpretation: Price, volume, funding announcements and quarter-end holdings measure different things. None alone measures real-time net capital flows. News reasons describe possible mechanisms, not measured effects.
